title: Histology: epithelium and connective tissue
intro: Dr. Imani Brooks runs the lab from the projection screen. Each bench has a microscope and a box of glass slides; you share yours with Priya from your small group. Find each tissue on low power, then go up.

steps.say: "Welcome to histology. Low power first: find the tissue and orient yourself. Then go up. Everything you see is stained with hematoxylin and eosin, so start there."
steps.speaker: Dr. Imani Brooks

steps.say: Slide 1. You bring the lining of a gut tube into focus.
"Now the connective tissues. Notice how the matrix changes with the job."
steps.speaker: Dr. Imani Brooks

steps.say: "Put your slides back in the right slots. Next week: glands and the skin. Good work today."
steps.speaker: Dr. Imani Brooks

feedback: Dr. Brooks initials your lab sheet: "You have an eye for this."
"Solid. Go back over the epithelia with the atlas this week."
"Histology is pattern recognition: it comes with practice. Come to Thursday's open lab."
